g.text: Keep cancellation and every robustness case visible
MATHEMATICAL SIMULATIONS. All 120 cancellation and 240 robustness streams are retained. Bars are 95% Wilson intervals. An input alert is not
necessarily successful detection of outcome deterioration: the outcome-only and correlation scenarios do not change the monitored marginal inputs. A
benign feature change need not harm the predictor. No new scenarios or algorithms were added in this follow-up.
